text:
QUOTE: "**Compile time:** define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` to your functions. Both must be set together ... **Run time:** leave the macros undefined and call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter. It never says the two are mutually exclusive. "Leave the macros undefined" only implies it, and the item needs that stated.
